title: Wednesday · storytelling, first prime factorization and Nevermoor
arrival: Settle in and answer attendance before handing in forms. Photo retakes will happen when students are called.
note: Wednesday starts with oral storytelling / Werewolf. Pause for photo retakes when called. Begin the first prime-factorization lesson after recess: the planned Tuesday maths did not happen. After lunch, protect time for Nevermoor from the actual class stopping point, followed by supported writing or work time. There is no local-candidate comparison block today. Introduce Halloween decoration choices and start only if materials are ready; otherwise continue Nevermoor. Prioritize more art time on Thursday, with finishing time likely needed next week. Friday October 23 is a non-instructional day. Student devices are not confirmed, so use paper, counters and teacher-led routines; no student login or upload is required.

blocks.title: Arrival and check-in
blocks.notes: Attendance before form collection. Settle in with a brief check-in and prepare for storytelling.
studentSteps: Hand in any forms after attendance.
Get ready to listen and take turns.

blocks.title: Oral storytelling · Werewolf
blocks.notes: Use the familiar oral storytelling / Werewolf routine. Practise listening, clear explanations and respectful turn-taking. Students needing photo retakes leave only when called and rejoin with a brief recap. Do not assign a fixed retake slot.
blocks.firstAction: Listen to the opening story and the rules.
studentSteps: Listen carefully and take turns.
Explain an idea using a detail from the story or round.
If you are called for a photo retake, follow the school routine and rejoin when you return.
blocks.firstActionKo: 이야기와 게임 규칙을 주의 깊게 들으세요.

blocks.title: Snack
blocks.firstAction: Put materials away and get your snack ready.

blocks.title: Maths · first prime-factorization lesson
blocks.notes: This is the first lesson, not consolidation: Tuesday maths was not taught. Start with 12 counters arranged in equal rows to recall factor pairs; drawings of counters work if needed. Show 12 = 3 × 4 = 3 × 2 × 2. Define prime and composite; 1 is neither. Use Math Antics: Prime Factorization as teacher-led explanation support, pausing to predict; the on-page worked trees provide a complete non-video route. Compare trees for 24 beginning with 4 × 6 and 3 × 8; both give 2 × 2 × 2 × 3. Keep repeated prime end factors and multiply back to check. Practise selected examples from 18, 30 and 36; 60 is optional. Finish with an independent tree and explanation for 42. Do not move automatically into GCF or assume earlier work is complete. Suggested hour: 5 minutes counters, 10 minutes video or explanation, 15 minutes modelling, 20 minutes supported practice, 10 minutes exit check.
blocks.firstAction: Get paper, a pencil and counters ready. Arrange 12 counters in equal rows.
studentSteps: Use 12 counters or drawn dots to show equal rows and name a factor pair.
Watch or listen to the model. Split composite end numbers until every end number is prime.
Try the practice numbers your teacher selects. Keep repeated prime factors.
Multiply the prime factors back together to check.
On your own, show a tree for 42 and explain why it is finished.
blocks.firstActionKo: 종이, 연필, 수 세기 도구를 준비하고 12개를 같은 수의 줄로 놓으세요.

activity.label: Prime factorization · Math Antics, trees and practice

blocks.title: Lunch
blocks.notes: Usual intermediate routine: outside 11:50–12:12; transition 12:12–12:13; eating 12:13–12:35.
blocks.firstAction: Follow our outside-play and lunch routine.
blocks.firstActionKo: 바깥 놀이와 점심시간에는 정해진 순서대로 하세요.

blocks.title: Quiet reset and Nevermoor
blocks.notes: Begin with a brief calm reset; quiet non-reading choices are available. Then continue Nevermoor from the actual class bookmark, since the planned Tuesday reading did not happen. Briefly recall only the last part actually read. Do not assume a chapter or story event. Read or listen, notice a character or setting detail, and explain an idea supported by that detail. Mark the new stopping point.
blocks.firstAction: Settle quietly, then find where our class actually stopped in Nevermoor.
studentSteps: Listen or read from our actual stopping point.
Notice one character or setting detail.
Say, draw or write an idea and the detail that supports it.
Mark where we stop and keep one question for next time.
blocks.firstActionKo: 조용히 자리를 잡고 지난번에 읽다가 멈춘 곳을 찾으세요.

blocks.title: Supported writing and work time
blocks.notes: Use paper-based writing or selected unfinished work. Start with one manageable next step and offer a model, word bank, partner rehearsal, drawing or an adult scribe as appropriate. A Nevermoor response can use: I think ___. A detail that supports my idea is ___. Keep individual support arrangements private. No devices or uploads are assumed.
blocks.firstAction: Choose the writing or unfinished task your teacher has selected.
studentSteps: Say your idea before writing, or start with a sketch.
Complete one clear next step and ask for help if needed.
Check your work and show what you have finished.
blocks.firstActionKo: 선생님과 정한 글쓰기나 끝내지 못한 활동을 시작하세요.

blocks.title: Pause and transition
blocks.notes: Short movement and materials transition before the flexible afternoon block.
blocks.firstAction: Save your place, stretch and listen for the next activity.
blocks.firstActionKo: 하던 곳을 표시하고 몸을 가볍게 움직인 뒤 다음 안내를 들으세요.

blocks.title: Halloween decorations · choices and possible start
blocks.notes: Introduce the available Halloween decoration choices. Show the actual materials and one safe making step before students choose. Start only if materials are ready; otherwise continue Nevermoor from the newly marked stopping point. Prioritize as much art time as practical on Thursday around fixed commitments; unfinished decorations may need more time next week because Friday is non-instructional. Do not require completion today.
blocks.firstAction: Look at the decoration choices your teacher shows and listen for whether we are starting art or continuing Nevermoor.
studentSteps: If materials are ready, choose a decoration and make a quick plan.
Follow the demonstrated safe first step and keep unfinished pieces together.
If art is not ready, return to our Nevermoor bookmark and continue listening or reading.
blocks.firstActionKo: 선생님이 보여 주는 장식을 살펴보고 미술을 시작할지 Nevermoor를 계속 읽을지 안내를 들으세요.

blocks.title: Planners, jobs and cleanup
blocks.notes: Restore our room and record confirmed reminders.
blocks.firstAction: Restore our room and record any confirmed reminders.
blocks.firstActionKo: 교실을 정리하고 확정된 안내 사항을 적으세요.

blocks.title: Classroom community
blocks.notes: Use a short check-in, appreciation or familiar cooperative game. Students may speak, draw, point or pass; keep feedback specific and avoid public rankings.
blocks.firstAction: Notice one helpful action from today.
studentSteps: Offer one specific appreciation or listen.
Name a small next step for tomorrow.
blocks.firstActionKo: 오늘 도움이 된 행동 한 가지를 떠올려 보세요.

blocks.title: Pack up and dismissal
blocks.firstAction: Check your belongings and get ready for a calm departure.
blocks.firstActionKo: 자기 물건을 확인하고 차분히 하교할 준비를 하세요.

backups: No student devices are assumed. Use paper, pencils, oral rehearsal and counters or drawn dots; no login or upload is required.
If the Math Antics video is unavailable, use the two worked trees for 24 on the companion or draw them on the board. Keep repeated prime factors and check the product.
Photo retakes happen when called. Give returning students a brief recap and a clear next step.
If art materials are not ready, continue Nevermoor from the actual stopping point. Carry unfinished decorations into Thursday and, if needed, next week.
Friday October 23 is a non-instructional day. Do not assign Friday class work or a new home deadline.
